invalid_arm.error: TopologyObserveSupersessionCancellationV1 exhausted its one-minute ScheduleToClose timeout after StartToClose timeouts

observation: The sole invalid pair was the child-Workflow arm of a protected executing-before-effect fanout-128 pair; its direct-Activity mate passed, and the other two child-Workflow repetitions of the same stratum passed in 18.5 and 42.4 seconds. The designated obsolete process registered and reached the before-effect/1 barrier at 2026-08-10T07:36:33Z. Supersession did not replace its owner until 2026-08-10T07:37:14Z under the 128-way child workload. The process log records that the still-open arrival POST ended with EOF, and no before-completion arrival was possible. The exact barrier HTTP server had a 30-second WriteTimeout even though an arrival response intentionally remains open until release.
inference: The exact barrier's transport response deadline expired before the registered experimental release. Releasing the coordinator after that deadline could not deliver a successful HTTP response, so the obsolete agent exited at before-effect and the cancellation observer retried a condition that could no longer become true. A server-side WriteTimeout is incompatible with this long-poll barrier protocol; liveness must instead be bounded by the caller context and Temporal Activity timeouts. This is a harness inference, not a Temporal guarantee or an application fencing failure.
falsifier: A deterministic reproduction in which an arrival released after the former response deadline returns successfully while the protected child/fanout-128 episode still exhausts cancellation observation, or durable evidence that the obsolete agent received a successful release response before failing to reach before-completion, would falsify this diagnosis.
correction: Remove the barrier HTTP WriteTimeout while retaining request-header, read, idle, caller-context, Activity, Workflow, and explicit shutdown bounds. Add a transport-level regression that holds an arrival across the former response deadline without a wall-clock sleep, then repeat the exact protected child/fanout-128 stratum and execute a new append-only pilot root. Preserve v3 as rejected.
